description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'codeTrackerInterface' for connecting and interacting with code tracking systems within the TestLink project. It includes methods for configuration, database connection management, and URL generation for code viewing.

classes.name: codeTrackerInterface
classes.description: An abstract base class for connecting to various code tracking systems, providing configuration, connection handling, and URL building functionalities.

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Returns the current configuration object for the code tracker.

methods.name: setCfg
methods.description: Sets the configuration from an XML string, parsing it into a SimpleXML object and converting to JSON for serialization.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface PHP configuration value.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection to the code tracking system based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection to the code tracking system is active.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection if active.

methods.name: buildViewCodeLink
methods.description: Generates an HTML link to view code in a new page based on project, repository, and code path.

methods.name: getEnterCodeURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for entering code links.

methods.name: buildViewCodeURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL to view specific code in the code tracking system.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Static method to be implemented by subclasses to provide configuration template.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Checks the environment for required dependencies; default returns OK.
